title: Hurricane Maria
description:
B-roll package of Iowa Air National Guard Security Forces members participating in a personnel recovery mission. The Iowa Security Forces are augmenting the 156th SFS, Puerto Rico ANG Base, during Hurricane Maria relief operations. Interview with U.S. Air National Guard Capt. Noemi Lopez, 156th Force Support Squadron, Muniz Air National Guard Base, Puerto Rico.
Hurricane Maria formed in the Atlantic Ocean and affected islands in the Caribbean Sea, including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. U.S. Military assets supported FEMA as well as state and local authorities in rescue and relief efforts. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Tayor Harrison)
keywords: ANG, Iowa Air National Guard, 156 Airlift Wing, First Combat Camera Squadron, security forces, NGB
